## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; sector confirmations: broad sector breadth ≥7/11 and cyclicals (Materials, Industrials, Financials) leading support the call. Leadership concentration: Narrow (4/5 Technology in top performers), which tempers the breadth signal.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: CRH (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +13.36%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND; breadth: Materials 9/11 positive. Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND and ETN (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +13.27%) ABOVE TREND; breadth: Industrials 12/15 positive. Financials solid: JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND; breadth: Financials 16/20 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.61%) TREND EXHAUSTION and CVX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND; breadth: Energy 2/10 positive. Communication under pressure: META (1W: +9.64% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY but sector -1.10% on the week; breadth: Communication 3/10 positive. Technology internally mixed with big dispersion: IBM (1W: -7.01% | 1M: -7.28%) BELOW TREND highlights pockets of weakness; breadth: Technology 14/24 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.64% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -16.68% | 1M: -20.08%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -13.74% | 1M: -15.53%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -11.65% | 1M: -14.81%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -10.07% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND; major divergence present — multiple large-caps (AAPL, META, V, MA, LLY) show 1W vs 1M sign mismatch, so watch for trend break despite strong momentum.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive with leadership in semis and select software; NVDA (1W: +6.34% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +7.26% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, while MSFT (1W: -0.69% | 1M: -8.40%) BELOW TREND and AAPL (1W: +1.78% | 1M: -0.13%) RECOVERY — Sector breadth: Technology 14/24 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?
Broad strength and cyclical leadership expected to continue; JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND with V (1W: +1.18% | 1M: -1.49%) RECOVERY and MA (1W: +1.23% | 1M: -0.89%) RECOVERY — Sector breadth: Financials 16/20 positive.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed defensive tone but selective movers: UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND confirming bullish news, JNJ (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -6.04%) RECOVERY — Sector breadth: Healthcare 10/17 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and select semiconductor leaders (INTC, LRCX, AMAT) and Financials (JPM) given strong breadth and earnings/contract news; reduce exposure to lagging high-multiple software names (NOW, INTU, CRM) and weak Energy names showing trend fatigue. Monitor the narrow Technology leadership and the 1W/1M divergences before expanding risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND — momentum extension likely; AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through candidate; UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND — news-confirmed move. BEARISH: NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND — at risk of further downside; PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND — negative sentiment confirmed; CVX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND — mixed headlines but price weak.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%) breadth 9/11 positive and Industrials (1W: +4.10% | 1M: +0.42%) breadth 12/15 positive. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -4.25% | 1M: +1.25%) breadth 2/10 positive and Communication (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -2.98%) breadth 3/10 positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +6.34% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND — hold above near-term consolidation for continued leadership. AAPL (1W: +1.78% | 1M: -0.13%) RECOVERY — watch support around prior-week lows for confirmation. JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND — break above recent swing highs would signal further Financials participation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+60): UnitedHealth (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND — price confirms bullish Medicare rate news. LLY (+50): Eli Lilly (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -6.04%) RECOVERY — GLP-1 pill launch positive but 1M lagging, watch follow-through. CVX (+60): Chevron (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND — major discovery news but price diverging, monitor for distribution/rotation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PSX (-60): Phillips 66 (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price both negative, downside risk elevated. CVX (-55): Chevron (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND — mixed headlines (bullish discovery vs geopolitical impact) create conflicting signals; price not confirming bullish headlines.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style favored; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow Technology leadership and multiple large-cap 1W/1M divergences (AAPL, META, V, MA, LLY) plus mixed sentiment on Energy (CVX/PSX) — watch for trend confirmation before broadening exposure.
